cards.name: Avacyn's Judgment
cards.oracleText:
Madness {X}{R} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
Avacyn's Judgment deals 2 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets. If this spell's madness cost was paid, it deals X damage divided as you choose among those permanents and/or players instead.

cards.name: Celestial Judgment
cards.oracleText: For each different power among creatures on the battlefield, choose a creature with that power. Destroy each creature not chosen this way.

cards.name: Dominaria's Judgment
cards.oracleText: Until end of turn, creatures you control gain protection from white if you control a Plains, from blue if you control an Island, from black if you control a Swamp, from red if you control a Mountain, and from green if you control a Forest.

cards.name: Faithbound Judge // Sinner's Judgment
cards.typeLine: Creature — Spirit Soldier // Enchantment — Aura Curse
cards.oracleText:
Defender, flying, vigilance
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this creature has two or fewer judgment counters on it, put a judgment counter on it.
As long as this creature has three or more judgment counters on it, it can attack as though it didn't have defender.
Disturb {5}{W}{W}
Enchant player
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a judgment counter on this Aura. Then if there are three or more judgment counters on it, enchanted player loses the game.
If Sinner's Judgment would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
